summary: German isolation of corallocins A–C from Hericium coralloides, with cultured-cell neurotrophic expression findings; no human cognitive efficacy inference.

sources.title: Corallocins A-C induce neurotrophic-factor expression in cultured astrocytes
sources.organization: Wittstein et al., Helmholtz Centre Braunschweig; J Nat Prod

organisms.geographic_context: Europe and other temperate regions; German primary chemistry research
organisms.part_and_preparation_note: Fruiting-body fungal extracts and isolated corallocins; chemical profile depends on culture and material
organisms.evidence_summary: German researchers isolated corallocins A-C and observed increased NGF and/or BDNF expression in cultured human astrocyte-line cells. This is not a human cognition trial or verified direct neurotrophin-receptor binding.
organisms.safety_summary: Wild identification, allergies, contamination, and long-term extract safety not clinically established.

cross_links.note: Compare distinct neurotrophic-factor cell assays across Hericium species; chemical similarity not proof of equivalent effects.
